ways.h2: Words, a logo, or a sign we drew

cards.title: Design your words
cards.line: Type anything. The price updates as you go, and you approve a drawing before we make it.

cards.title: Send a logo
cards.line: A designer redraws your artwork as tube and sends a mockup with the price within 12 hours. Free.

cards.title: Shop ready-made
cards.line: Forty-eight signs we already drew, in your colour and size, with 14-day returns.

shop.h2: Pick the room, we'll start the drawing
shop.lede: Every collection opens the designer with the right scene and a sign that already fits the wall.

how.h2: Approve the drawing. We make exactly that.

steps.title: Design it
steps.line: Type your words, pick the lettering, colour and size. The price is live, and nothing is hidden until checkout.

steps.title: Approve the drawing
steps.line: Within 12 hours you get a proof drawing like the one here: exact words, letter height, overall size. Tweaks are free.

steps.title: We make it
steps.line: Your tube is bent, mounted on acrylic and tested in a UK workshop. Add a dimmer and remote if you want to dim it from the sofa.

steps.title: Hang it
steps.line: Screws and standoffs, chains, adhesive strips or a stand: you pick the fitting in the designer and it comes in the box.

how.sheetCaption: Drawn live from your words, at Medium

size.h2: Real size, on a real wall
size.lede: Your words, drawn to scale on a rendered room, with a real price for every size. Slide to see how much wall each one takes.

colour.h2: Twelve colours. Two jackets. One honest off-state.
colour.lede: The jacket is the silicone sleeve around the LEDs. White looks white when it's off; a coloured one keeps your colour by day. Both are rendered here with your words.

best.lede: Our most-ordered designs. Change the colour or size, or open one in the designer and make it yours.
best.quickReturns: Ready-made signs can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

built.lede: The parts that matter, named plainly. We only print a number once the workshop has measured it.

tube.title: Tube
tube.body: Flexible silicone LED neon with a dense LED pitch, so the line reads as one unbroken glow. {fact}

backing.title: Backing
backing.body: {fact} Cut to the shape of your words or to a clean rectangle, with polished edges.

tested.title: Tested
tested.body: {fact} Every sign carries a two-year warranty, and it was made in a UK workshop.

built.paragraph: Every sign is made in a UK workshop, from a drawing you approved, and carries a two-year warranty. The workshop is measuring the rest, so the numbers arrive as facts, not guesses.

logo.h2: Send the logo. Get a mockup and a price.
logo.body: Send the logo, get a mockup and a price within 12 hours. Nothing is made until you approve the drawing.
logo.bandsNote: Indicative; your mockup carries the exact price

bands.use: A small logo or wordmark for a counter or a shelf
Most shop, café and salon signs
Large and custom builds, quoted by hand

daynight.lede: Drag the line. By day you see the honest off-state; at night the room relights around your words.

quiz.line: Three questions, and we draw three signs with real prices. Open any of them in the designer.

made.h2: Bent, mounted and tested in a UK workshop
made.lede: Acrylic cut to your outline, tube fitted by hand, every sign lit on the bench before it ships.

compare.lede: A plain comparison. The right-hand column is what the category typically offers, not a claim about any named brand.

rows.label: Lead time
rows.us: 7–10 working days after you approve the drawing

led.title: LED neon (what we make)
led.body: Silicone tube around LEDs. Low voltage, cool to the touch, bends into script, survives the post and a toddler.

glass.title: Glass neon
glass.body: Gas in hand-blown glass. Beautiful, fragile, high voltage, and best left to a specialist installer.

ledGlass.link: We make LED neon; here's why →

kit.eyebrow: What you get, how it hangs, what it costs, how it arrives
kit.h2: In the box, on the wall

arrives.title: Arrives safe
arrives.body: Your sign travels in a rigid box with foam corners around the acrylic, the power supply and remote packed beside it, and the fixings in a labelled bag. {tested} {weight} {packaging}
arrives.tracked: Delivery is tracked, and we send the tracking link the day it leaves.

faq.h2: The questions people ask before they order
faq.lede: Straight answers. Every one links to its full version in the help centre.
faq.empty: Nothing matches that yet. Try another word, or ask us.
faq.askBody: Ask a person who makes the signs. We reply to every message.

save.h2: Still thinking? Email me my design
save.lede: We send you a link to exactly what you typed, with its price. It reopens in the designer whenever you're ready.
save.consent: Also send me occasional ideas and offers (unsubscribe any time)
save.alt: Or open it in the designer
save.success: Your design and its price are on their way. The link reopens the designer exactly as you left it.
save.errorTitle: We couldn't send that just now
save.errorBody: Nothing was lost. Try again, or open the design in the designer and save it from there.
save.localSaved: Saved locally (review build) — nothing was sent.
save.emailInvalid: That email doesn't look complete — check the part after the @.
